### Matthew B. Jané [PhD candidate, MS, BS]{.degree-suffix}
*Founder and Lead Auditor* | <a class="ace-orcid" href="https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3121-7769" rel="me"><svg class="ace-orcid-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path fill="currentColor" d="M12 0C5.372 0 0 5.372 0 12s5.372 12 12 12 12-5.372 12-12S18.628 0 12 0zM7.369 4.378c.525 0 .947.431.947.947s-.422.947-.947.947a.95.95 0 0 1-.947-.947c0-.525.422-.947.947-.947zm-.722 3.038h1.444v10.041H6.647V7.416zm3.562 0h3.9c3.712 0 5.344 2.653 5.344 5.025 0 2.578-2.016 5.025-5.325 5.025h-3.919V7.416zm1.444 1.303v7.444h2.297c3.272 0 4.022-2.484 4.022-3.722 0-2.016-1.284-3.722-4.097-3.722h-2.222z"/></svg>ORCID</a>

Matthew is a PhD candidate in Quantitative Psychology at the University of Connecticut, where his work focuses on statistical methods for meta-analysis and forensic meta-science. Within ACE, he leads study identification, report development, statistical analyses, and project standards.
